card.title: Yes, Under My Physics
card.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely, I'll help move your boxes downstairs. Help means saving effort; I'll call the lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's broken. Carry that box yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Yourself means without involving you. I'll hire a mover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll carry them if you hold the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Holding means preventing movement. I'll wedge the door open and supervise from this chair.

mechanism: A agrees to help move boxes but redefines every personal-action term so others or devices perform the labor.
confusable: Unlike open refusal to help, A must maintain complete agreement while changing what the requests require.
comparison: Hired labor and a door wedge preserve seated supervision, unlike the portrait subject keeping shade through camera definitions.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
